title: Genome-wide knockout screen of OC43/SARS-CoV2-infected HEK293-hACE2 cells II
model: HEK293T-hACE2 cells, Brunello genome-wide knockout library, SARS-CoV-2 MOI 0.3 survival selection
contrast: SARS-CoV-2 vs uninfected day-10 control library (3 vs 3)
paper_method: MAGeCK RRA, positively selected genes (Additional file 7)
paper_calls: CTSL, CCZ1B, TMEM251, ACE2, C18orf8, CCZ1, CDH2 (endolysosomal entry factors)
barcs_calls: 41 genes at FDR 0.10 (31 enriched) after control calibration; 63 against the control null
named_hits: 7/7 at FDR 0.10: TMEM251 #1, CTSL #2, CCZ1B #3, CCZ1 #4, CDH2 #8, ACE2 #17, C18orf8 #25
verdict: BARCS recovers all seven named endolysosomal entry factors at FDR 0.10, with TMEM251, CTSL and the CCZ1 complex at the very top (rank correlation 0.62, 16 of 20 shared).
